subject: Can we run orderMarkers command using multi-core for larger marker data?

messages.author: 93090b136a6c8b7c
messages.subject: Can we run orderMarkers command using multi-core for larger marker data?
parts:
Hi Karl,

I wanted to know if it is possible to run orderMarkers command using multi-core like we do in the case of ripple, as for larger marker data in single chromosome it is taking so much time, even though i have sufficient core to use in the process. My objective here to get genetic map first. If you can please guide me in this scenario. Thanks in advance.

messages.author: 04e62c3b36bb17bf
messages.subject: Re: Can we run orderMarkers command using multi-core for larger marker data?
parts:
To order markers and build a map de-novo, orderMarkers is probably not the best option. It is pretty slow with large datasets.
Other map construction algorithms might be better. I'm partial to tspMap (https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pubmed/29270228), but I'm biased. There are a lot of other options out there. 
Hope this helps, 
John

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: Can we run orderMarkers command using multi-core for larger marker data?
parts:
orderMarkers can't be run multicore. You could use the parallel package to have the chromosomes run in parallel, but the approach for a single chromosome can't be parallelized.

karl
